_note: Week of June 8–14, 2026. Taco Tuesday (fresh chicken + shrimp). Salmon midweek boost on Wed. Jake lunch: turkey black bean bowl v2 — same format, added jalapeño kick. Laine lunch: mason jar pasta salad v2 — cucumber swap for cherry tomatoes, still tuna + chicken. Slight protein bump week over week.

dinners.name: Garlic Herb Cod + Sweet Potato + Frozen Veg
dinners.note: Clean Monday reset. Cod stays mild and easy. Sweet potato swaps in for quinoa — more carbs for Jake's volume, better texture variety.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, paprika, dried oregano, salt

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Cube sweet potato, toss in oil + salt, roast 25 min until fork-tender.
Thaw cod in cold water 20 min. Pat dry, season with garlic powder, paprika, oregano, salt.
Heat remaining oil in non-stick over medium-high. Cook cod 3-4 min per side.
Steam/microwave frozen veggies.
Plate: sweet potato base, cod on top, veggies alongside. Squeeze lemon over fish.

dinners.name: Chicken + Shrimp Tacos
dinners.note: Fresh chicken taco Tuesday — no leftover reliance. Jake loads up on chicken, Laine keeps shrimp as the lead protein. Simple seasoning, fast cook.
steps: Slice chicken thin. Season with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt.
Cook chicken in oil over medium-high 3-4 min per side until cooked through. Rest 2 min, slice.
In same pan, cook shrimp 2 min per side with remaining seasoning.
Warm tortillas on dry pan or open flame 30 sec each side.
Build tacos: Jake more chicken, Laine more shrimp. Top with cheese + sour cream.

dinners.name: Baked Salmon + Quinoa + Roasted Veg
dinners.note: Salmon midweek — omega-3 boost. Quinoa for fiber. Jake gets the bigger fillet. Roasted frozen veg instead of steamed for better texture.
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with foil.
Pat salmon dry, brush with oil, season with garlic powder, paprika, salt. Bake 14-16 min.
Cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2x water 15 min, fluff. Jake 60g dry, Laine 50g dry.
Toss frozen veg with a splash of oil and roast alongside salmon last 12 min.
Plate: quinoa base, salmon on top. Finish with lemon over the fish.

dinners.name: Ground Turkey + Pinto Bean Skillet
dinners.note: Pinto bean variation on the W23 black bean skillet. Slightly different flavor profile — earthier, good with garlic basil sauce this time. Jake bigger bowl.
steps: Brown turkey in skillet over medium-high, breaking up. Season with cumin, chili, garlic powder.
Add pinto beans + pasta sauce. Stir in frozen veggies.
Simmer 8-10 min until thickened and veggies tender.
Jake gets bigger bowl. Top both with shredded cheese.

dinners.name: Shrimp + Egg White Skillet
dinners.note: High protein, low carb Friday. Shrimp and egg whites in one pan — fast, clean, filling. Cheese on top. Veggies folded in.
steps: Thaw shrimp, pat dry, season with garlic powder, paprika, salt.
Cook shrimp in oil over medium-high 2 min per side. Remove and set aside.
In same pan over medium-low, add veggies and cook 3 min. Pour in egg whites.
Stir gently until egg whites just set. Fold shrimp back in.
Top with cheese. Plate immediately.

dinners.name: Garlic Basil Shrimp Pasta
dinners.note: Same crowd-pleaser as W23 Saturday. Signature Select garlic basil sauce, spinach stirred in, bread crumbs on top. Jake bigger portion.
steps: Boil pasta in salted water until al dente. Reserve ¼ cup pasta water. Drain.
Cook shrimp in oil over medium-high with garlic powder + salt, 2 min per side.
Add pasta sauce to pan, stir in spinach until wilted (1-2 min). Add splash of pasta water to loosen.
Toss in cooked pasta. Jake bigger bowl.
Top with bread crumbs. Serve immediately.

dinners.name: Birch Benders Pancake Night + Egg White Scramble
dinners.note: Standing Sunday breakfast-for-dinner. Flaxseed in the batter. Thawed frozen fruit on top. Jake bigger stack.
steps: Thaw frozen fruit at room temp or microwave 60 sec.
Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water (per pkg). Stir in flaxseed.
Cook on greased griddle over medium, 2-3 min per side.
Jake gets bigger stack. Top both with thawed fruit.

jakeLunch.name: Ground Turkey + Black Bean Bowl with Roasted Onion Garlic Sauce
jakeLunch.note: W24 version. Same format as W23 — make 5 containers Sunday. Added small jalapeño kick option. Jake's workhorse lunch.

ingredients.item: Ground turkey 85/15 — 2.5 lbs total, 227g raw per container
Black beans — 2 cans total, 0.4 can per container
Signature Select roasted onion & garlic sauce — 2.5 cups total, 1/2 cup per container
Frozen edamame (shelled) — 2.5 cups total, 1/2 cup per container
Frozen veggies — 5 cups total, 1 cup per container
Cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt

steps: Brown ALL turkey (2.5 lbs) in large pan over medium-high, breaking up. Season with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt.
Add roasted onion garlic sauce. Stir in black beans and edamame. Simmer 8-10 min.
Steam/microwave all frozen veggies separately. Set aside.
Divide into 5 containers: turkey+bean mixture base, then 1 cup veggies on top.
Top each with 2 tbsp shredded cheese. Seal and refrigerate. Reheat 2 min with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Tuna & Chicken Pasta Salad — Mason Jar Style (Cherry Tomato Edition)
laineLunch.note: W24 rotation: cherry tomatoes replace bell pepper for variety. Same mason jar format, dressing separate. 2 sittings per jar. Laine approved.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Light Italian or Caesar — 2 tbsp per jar in a separate container.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 2 breasts (~800g raw), 147g raw per jar
Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 250g dry total, 50g per jar
Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Cherry tomatoes — 1 pint total, ~80g per jar
Fresh baby spinach — big handful per jar (~30g)
Light Italian or Caesar dressing — 2 tbsp per jar (kept separate)
Lemon juice, garlic powder, salt (for chicken)

steps: Season chicken with garlic powder, salt, pepper. Bake at 400°F for 24 min. Cool completely, dice small.
Cook all pasta in salted water. Drain, rinse cold, toss with tiny bit of olive oil.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Slice cucumber. Rinse spinach.
Drain tuna cans well.
Layer each mason jar: pasta → tuna → cucumber → cherry tomatoes → chicken → spinach on top.
Put 2 tbsp dressing in a separate small container per jar. Refrigerate.
When eating: pour dressing in, shake, eat half — reseal for second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into bowl or jar. Top with thawed fruit and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble
steps: Scramble egg whites over medium-low with frozen veggies until just set. Top with cheese.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Pancakes + Fruit

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake mix — 1/2 cup dry

steps: Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water. Cook small pancakes 2 min per side. Top with fruit + flaxseed.

jakeSnacks.name: Egg White Mug + Shredded Cheese
jakeSnacks.desc: 1/2 cup liquid egg whites microwaved in a mug 90 sec. Top with 1 tbsp shredded cheese.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Add hot sauce or lemon.

jakeSnacks.name: Frozen Edamame (shelled) + Flaxseed
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup edamame thawed/microwaved + 1 tbsp flaxseed. Great fiber + protein combo.
